summary: Validated Reports auto-refresh (silent polling every ~30s), freshness indicator (green/yellow/red pill), manual tap-to-refresh, Kitchen manual refresh button, and regression on kitchen row non-clickable + order status recalculation. 9/9 backend tests pass, all UI flows verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Auto-refresh implemented correctly in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/reports.tsx lines 220-256 with setInterval(30000) + window.focus/online listeners, cleanup on unmount. Freshness computed via nowTs clock ticking every 5s (fresh <45s, stale >=45s, error on catch).

During observation window we captured 6 kitchen calls in ~65s (expected ~2-3). Extra calls are likely triggered by window.focus events fired by the Playwright/dev environment; not a real bug but worth noting. In production browsers focus events fire less often. The setInterval + focus combination is standard React polling pattern.

Note: silentSyncReports fetches unpaid via ordersApi.getUnpaidByRange which hits GET /api/orders?unpaid_only=true (not /api/orders/unpaid as the review request expected). URL pattern is correct - just different from spec description.
Backend calculate_order_status() logic verified: all pending->in_attesa, mix->in_preparazione, all ready->pronto, any problem->sospeso. 4 new pytest cases (test_order_status_recalc.py) all pass.

Kitchen regression from iteration_3 still holds: row remains a non-interactive View; only kitchen-complete-btn TouchableOpacity toggles itemStatus. E2E verified: tapping 'Completa' set itemStatus=ready and order.status=pronto correctly.
test_credentials: N/A - Reports/Kitchen accessible without login. Admin password 'eligesoft' for settings modal (not needed).
seed_data_creation: Created temporary category TEST_UIKitchenCat, dish TEST_UIKitchenDish, order with 3 units flagged sendToKitchen=true; used for UI E2E test then fully cleaned up (categories/dishes/order deleted). Backend tests use module-scoped fixtures with teardown cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-refresh + freshness indicator on Reports tab is production-ready. During Playwright observation we saw more than 2 kitchen calls per minute (6 in 65s) likely due to window.focus events firing from the automation environment; this is not a real regression in production browsers but worth noting if the observed request count seems high. The indicator testID is 'report-sync-indicator'; kitchen refresh testID is 'kitchen-refresh'; complete button testID prefix is 'kitchen-complete-btn'. The unpaid URL is /api/orders?unpaid_only=true (not /orders/unpaid). All iteration_3 regressions intact.
